description: Replayed from the Windows tester's frames (24 Nov 2026, Freshworks matter, build ca9ddcad3): the first session runs on gpt-6.1-terra, Codex's own current value, at low; after the idle stop the relaunch's session/load lists the options of agent-options.json exactly (no gpt-6.1-terra, current gpt-6.1-sol, low). The model is truly gone: the client sets nothing and the second prompt runs on 6.1 Sol (a set before it is a mismatch). The first list is the relaunch's with gpt-6.1-terra added, as the frames hold no first-session list.

note: The first launch sends session/new, the relaunch after the idle stop session/load; the branch picks by method.
